ideas.pitch: A comprehensive full-stack Python application with an integrated Flask backend, React frontend, and an embedded Gen-AI code assistant tailored for rapid prototyping.
ideas.title: PyFullStack GenAI Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with the core curriculum of the Quality Thought training demo by combining Python backend development, SQL databases, and generative AI capabilities into a cohesive, working demo.

ideas.pitch: A full-stack Python tool that uses local LLMs to automatically generate and validate SQL migration scripts from natural language descriptions of schema changes.
ideas.title: SchemaMorph: AI-Driven Database Migrator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a genuinely hard engineering problem for developers managing databases, showcasing both advanced Python backend skills and practical Gen-AI integration.

ideas.pitch: A Flask and React application that inspects incoming Python REST API routes and uses Generative AI to instantly produce interactive documentation and mock test data.
ideas.title: RestAI: Automated API Documentation and Mock Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a universal pain point for software developers and students building full-stack applications, highlighting mastery of APIs, front-end, and back-end integration.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight Python utility that hooks into local Git repositories to perform automated pre-commit code reviews using a lightweight embedded LLM.
ideas.title: GitGenie: Local AI Code Review Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the success of offline AI developer tools by focusing on developer productivity, Git integration, and practical offline AI deployment.

ideas.pitch: An interactive web application that helps students and junior developers map out and auto-generate cloud deployment configuration files using a conversational Gen-AI interface.
ideas.title: CloudDeploy Navigator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Taps directly into the cloud fundamentals and deployment topics covered in the training demo, making complex cloud workflows accessible to beginners and freshers.
